# Ingestion

Ingestion transforms raw documents into searchable chunks indexed in a vector store. You can swap pipeline components based on your needs.

A `FileLoader` reads raw bytes from a source (local filesystem, cloud storage, or any custom source) and returns a `File` object.

A `DocumentExtractor` converts that `File` into a structured `Document` by parsing PDFs via OCR, converting HTML to Markdown, or reading plain text depending on the file type.

A `TextSplitter` divides the `Document` into smaller `DocumentChunk` objects. The strategy and chunk size directly affect retrieval quality.

Optional `DocumentProcessor` stages (such as a `ChunkEnricher` or `SummaryEnricher`) add metadata to each chunk before indexing, for example an LLM-generated summary or entity tags.

An `Embedder` converts each chunk into a vector, and the store persists both the vector and the raw text for search.

## Pipeline {#pipeline}

`Pipeline` is the main entry point. It handles file loading, extraction, chunking, embedding, and indexing. It supports batch processing with concurrency, progress tracking, and checkpointing.

```python
from mistralai.search.toolkit.ingestion.pipelines import Pipeline
from mistralai.client import Mistral
from mistralai.search.toolkit.embedding import MistralEmbedder, MODEL_1024_EMBEDDING
from mistralai.search.toolkit.ingestion.extractors import PlainTextExtractor
from mistralai.search.toolkit.ingestion.loaders import FilesystemFileLoader
from mistralai.search.toolkit.ingestion.text_splitters import CharacterTextSplitter
from mistralai.search.toolkit.ingestion.enrichment import SummaryEnricher
from mistralai.search.toolkit.llm import MistralChat, LLMConfig
from mistralai.search.toolkit.plugins.vespa import VespaClientConfig
from vespa_app import app

mistral_client = Mistral(api_key="...")
llm = MistralChat(client=mistral_client, config=LLMConfig(model="mistral-small-latest"))

collection_name = "my_collection"
config = VespaClientConfig(
    endpoint="http://localhost:8080",
)

vector_store = app.get_search_index(config, collection_name=collection_name)

pipeline = Pipeline(
    loader=FilesystemFileLoader(),
    extractor=PlainTextExtractor(),
    text_splitter=CharacterTextSplitter(chunk_size=512),
    processors=[SummaryEnricher(llm_provider=llm)],
    embedder=MistralEmbedder(client=mistral_client, model_name=MODEL_1024_EMBEDDING),
    stores=vector_store,
)

num_chunks = await pipeline.run(documents=["doc1.txt", "doc2.txt"])
```

> **Info**
>
> `collection_name` (passed to `app.get_search_index`) selects which schema/collection your chunks are indexed into. Use the same name when retrieving documents later.

### Checkpointing

For large document collections, enable checkpointing to recover from failures:

```python
from mistralai.search.toolkit.ingestion.progress import create_tqdm_progress_callback
from mistralai.search.toolkit.ingestion.enrichment import SummaryEnricher
from mistralai.search.toolkit.storage import FilesystemStorage

pipeline = Pipeline(
    loader=FilesystemFileLoader(),
    extractor=extractor,
    text_splitter=splitter,
    processors=[SummaryEnricher(llm_provider=llm)],
    embedder=embedder,
    stores=vector_store,
    checkpoint_store=lambda: FilesystemStorage("./checkpoints"),
)

num_chunks = await pipeline.run(
    documents=document_paths,
    use_checkpoint=True,
    progress_callback=create_tqdm_progress_callback(),
)
```

On restart, documents with existing checkpoint files are skipped.

### Route files by type with `RoutedPipeline`

`RoutedPipeline` routes files to protocol-specific pipelines based on file extension and MIME type. Use it when ingesting mixed-format document collections. It selects the extractor and processing pipeline for each file type.

#### Protocols

`RoutedPipeline` ships with 9 built-in protocols. Each protocol maps a set of file types to the appropriate extractor pipeline:

| Protocol | File types |
|----------|-----------|
| `ocr` | PDF, DOCX, PPTX, ODT, EPUB |
| `plain_text` | TXT, MD, CSV, JS, PY, JSON, YAML, ... |
| `html` | HTML, HTM |
| `xlsx` | XLSX, XLS, ODS |
| `numbers` | NUMBERS |
| `legacy_office` | DOC, PPT, HWP, HWPX |
| `email` | EML, MSG |
| `image` | PNG, JPEG, GIF, WebP |
| `audio` | MP3, WAV, M4A, FLAC, OGG |

#### Use default protocols

Basic usage with default protocols:

```python
from mistralai.search.toolkit.ingestion.pipelines import RoutedPipeline

router = RoutedPipeline({
    "ocr": ocr_pipeline,
    "html": html_pipeline,
    "plain_text": text_pipeline,
    "xlsx": spreadsheet_pipeline,
})

document = await router.run_file(file=file)
```

#### Parameters

| Parameter | Description |
|-----------|-------------|
| `pipelines` | Dictionary mapping protocol names to `Pipeline` instances |
| `mime_registry` | Optional custom MIME registry for file-type detection |
| `protocol_overrides` | Optional dictionary to override the default protocol for specific file extensions |

#### Override the default protocol

Force specific file extensions to use a different protocol:

```python
router = RoutedPipeline(
    pipelines={
        "ocr": ocr_pipeline,
        "html": html_pipeline,
        "plain_text": text_pipeline,
        "xlsx": spreadsheet_pipeline,
    },
    protocol_overrides={
        ".doc": "ocr",  # Force legacy docs through OCR instead of legacy_office
    },
)

document = await router.run_file(file=file)
```

## Components {#components}

Each ingestion component is documented in detail with configuration options, best practices, and examples:

- **[File loaders](https://docs.mistral.ai/studio/search/search-toolkit/ingestion/loaders)**: load files from filesystem, cloud storage, or custom sources
- **[Document extractors](https://docs.mistral.ai/studio/search/search-toolkit/ingestion/extractors)**: extract content from PDFs, HTML, spreadsheets, and more
- **[Text splitters](https://docs.mistral.ai/studio/search/search-toolkit/ingestion/splitters)**: divide documents into chunks with the size and overlap you choose
- **[Chunk enrichers](https://docs.mistral.ai/studio/search/search-toolkit/ingestion/enrichers)**: add custom metadata for filtering and ranking
- **[Embedders](https://docs.mistral.ai/studio/search/search-toolkit/ingestion/embedders)**: convert text to vectors for semantic search
- **[Search index](https://docs.mistral.ai/studio/search/search-toolkit/search-index)**: store and search over indexed chunks

# Ingestion

Ingestion transforms raw documents into searchable chunks indexed in a vector store. You can swap pipeline components based on your needs.

A `FileLoader` reads raw bytes from a source (local filesystem, cloud storage, or any custom source) and returns a `File` object.

A `DocumentExtractor` converts that `File` into a structured `Document` by parsing PDFs via OCR, converting HTML to Markdown, or reading plain text depending on the file type.

A `TextSplitter` divides the `Document` into smaller `DocumentChunk` objects. The strategy and chunk size directly affect retrieval quality.

Optional `DocumentProcessor` stages (such as a `ChunkEnricher` or `SummaryEnricher`) add metadata to each chunk before indexing, for example an LLM-generated summary or entity tags.

An `Embedder` converts each chunk into a vector, and the store persists both the vector and the raw text for search.

## Pipeline {#pipeline}

The stages of an ingestion `Pipeline` are:

- **Required:** `loader`, `extractor`, `text_splitter`, `embedder`, `stores`
- **Optional:** `processors` (e.g., `ChunkEnricher`, `SummaryEnricher`)

[Ingestion > Pipeline](https://docs.mistral.ai/studio/search/search-toolkit/ingestion#pipeline)

Your `TypeError` is likely because one of the required arguments (`loader`, `extractor`, `text_splitter`, `embedder`, or `stores`) is missing when you instantiate `Pipeline`.
